notes: Taiwan professional brand (everfocus.com), EverFocus Electronics Corp. Official EverFocus IP-camera RTSP path (EZN Series manual) is rtsp://[IP]:[Port]/ch01/[A] with A=0 main / 1 sub / 2 mobile; default port 554 (configurable 1024-65535). This confirms the lead /ch01/0. NOTE: EverFocus RECORDERS use different syntax not published as camera templates — EPRO NVR Series uses /ip[A]/[B] (e.g. /ip01/0), and EMV800-HD/older DVRs use /3GPP/[channel]. The legacy /cgi-bin/rtspStreamOvf/[N] path (main=1 or per some sources) appears only in third-party VMS setup guides for older EverFocus models and could not be confirmed against an official manufacturer manual, so it is left in unverified_leads.
